title: Modular A/V: Vines theme
description: Frames that look grown from branches, with ivy, for the cameras of the Modular A/V dock: no two the same shape. The ivy turns to autumn while its player is muted, and a soft light shows on the picture while they speak. Best with the scattered layout.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
